brief.text: Cluster thesis is INTACT (mid), downgraded from strengthening on 2026-09-15. Demand evidence is unchanged (GEV, BE, VRT all raised FY26 guidance), but two facts show backlog is not near-term margin: GLJ's vintage math puts GEV's 2027 deliveries at ~3pp backlog margin vs 10-11pp on 2028, and VRT missed Q2 revenue by ~$110M on timing. Live ranks 09-15: BE 1, GEV 2, VRT 3; VST 4 and FSLR 5 stand from 09-09. Falsifiers: GEV Q3 (10-28) orders down QoQ, VRT Q3 (10-21) book-to-bill <1.0, or a top-4 hyperscaler cutting 2027 capex before 11-15. All secondary. KEY: Downgrade strengthening to intact 09-15: margin timing, not demand (GLJ vintage math; VRT Q2 miss); BE rank 1 case against: ~95x FY26 EPS, +190% YTD, beta 1.68; its ~$14B long-dated backlog vintage lag is untested, no source; Reorder triggers: VRT Q3 10-21 in line/beat and book-to-bill >=1.2 moves VRT above GEV; US10Y >5.25% before 10-15 likely costs BE rank 1; Margin pool moving toward scarce long-lead generation (GEV 2028+) and on-site power (BE); away from in-hall assembly and pre-2025 fixed-price backlog; Bench: ETN, PWR, CEG, VST, each with a stated entry condition. OPEN: Does a second sell-side shop publish a vintage backlog-margin cut on VRT, ETN or BE before 10-31, making the mechanism cluster-wide?; Does the VST Texas data-center-pause overhang (09-09) still apply? It was not re-checked 09-15.; Does ETN Q3 show data-center orders with price realization? The date is TBD..
